# liblzma 5.8.1 — pinned vendored build recipe (FloeAndroid, lane job-bf610b6f22fe42ab)

Purpose: replace Apple-only `Compression` framework LZMA (`COMPRESSION_LZMA`,
which the original `ArchiveCodecs.swift` uses for complete `.xz` streams)
with the reference implementation on Android, keeping tar.xz/.xz real native
format support with bounded streaming decode/encode.

## Pins (verified 2026-10-24)
- Official: `https://tukaani.org/xz/xz-5.8.1.tar.gz`
  SHA-256 `507825b599356c10dca1cd720c9d0d0c9d5400b9de300af00e4d1ea150795543`
- Cross-checked byte-identical GitHub release asset
  `github.com/tukaani-project/xz/releases/download/v5.8.1/xz-5.8.1.tar.gz`.
  (Chosen post-2024-supply-chain-incident release line; 5.6.3+ era fixes.)
- License: 0BSD for liblzma + src/common tuklib headers (`COPYING.0BSD`
  retained).

## Vendored scope
`src/liblzma/**` (check/common/delta/lz/lzma/rangecoder/simple + api),
`src/common/**` (mythread/sysdefs/tuklib headers, tuklib_physmem.c),
`floe/config.h` platform selector + `floe/config-macos.h` +
`floe/config-android.h` = the exact `config.h` files generated by the two
CMake invocations below (XZ_THREADS=no static Release), frozen, plus
`floe/verify-compile.sh` and `SOURCE-PIN.json`. CLI tools/tests/doc/po not
vendored.

## Reproduction (both verified on this host; 74/74 objects, 0 warnings)
```bash
FLAGS="-DXZ_THREADS=no -DXZ_DOC=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
  -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON"
cmake -S xz-5.8.1 -B build-macos  $FLAGS            && cmake --build build-macos  --target liblzma
cmake -S xz-5.8.1 -B build-android \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$NDK/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake" \
  -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-28 \
  -DANDROID_SUPPORT_FLEXIBLE_PAGE_SIZES=ON $FLAGS   && cmake --build build-android --target liblzma
```
The frozen configs reproduce those builds' macro sets; `verify-compile.sh`
compiles all 74 units with ONLY `-DHAVE_CONFIG_H` + include paths, proving
the SwiftPM definition set is self-sufficient (objects are not linked;
16 KiB alignment belongs to Main's final `.so` link — NDK r30 passes
`-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384` via `-DANDROID_SUPPORT_FLEXIBLE_PAGE_SIZES=ON`
for executable/shared links).

## SwiftPM target proposal (Main applies to shared/Package.swift)
```swift
.target(
    name: "CLzma",
    path: "Vendor/Archive/xz-5.8.1",
    sources: /* explicit list: src/common/tuklib_physmem.c + the 73 src/liblzma/*.c units
                (same list verify-compile.sh uses; keeps multithreaded files out:
                 XZ_THREADS=no) */,
    publicHeadersPath: "src/liblzma/api",
    cSettings: [
        .define("HAVE_CONFIG_H"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/api"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/common"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/check"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/lz"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/rangecoder"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/lzma"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/delta"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/liblzma/simple"),
        .headerSearchPath("src/common"),
        .headerSearchPath("floe"),
    ]
)
```
`CFloeArchive` depends on `CLzma` + `CBZip2`; `floe_xz.c` includes `<lzma.h>`.
TUKLIB_SYMBOL_PREFIX is already inside the frozen config (consumed only by
internal headers). No Package.resolved entry.

## Behavior contract (matches what ArchiveCodecs documents)
- One `floe_xz_decoder` decodes exactly one `.xz` member; LZMA_CONCATENATED
  is NOT set, so the member end is reported with byte-exact `consumed`
  (concatenated streams are located by decoding, like the Apple path).
- The stream's own integrity check (CRC32/CRC64/SHA-256) is verified by
  liblzma itself; unknown check methods and unsupported filter chains are
  permanent failures, never silently skipped.
- Encoder: standard `.xz` container, single LZMA2 filter, default preset 6,
  CRC64 check — validated by Python `lzma` (decode both presets + SHA256 +
  CRC32 check variants) and by `xz` consumers in the engine's interop tests.
- Reference-produced `.xz` files (preset 0 and 9, CRC64/SHA256/CRC32) decode
  with exact boundary accounting (lane C driver evidence:
  r1/archive-network/tools/floe_codec_driver.c + reference-decode runs).

## Overlay additions (documented, this lane)
`src/liblzma/api/module.modulemap` — single-header module over `lzma.h`. A
plain `publicHeadersPath` umbrella would make clang include every
`lzma/*.h` sub-header standalone, which upstream headers forbid
("Never include this file directly"). No upstream file was modified.
